duration.$description: Durations of states rather than motion: how long something stays before it changes back. Unlike transitions, they stay the same when the reader prefers reduced motion.

confirmation.$description: Use for how long a confirmation stays, such as a copy button's check after copying, before the control returns to its resting state.

catchUp.$description: Component token for the furthest streamed text in a transcript may fall behind what has arrived. Further behind, the reveal speeds up from `number.transcript.reveal.pace` so that what arrived shows within this time.
